# Class: `TrainingSession`

Holds parsed session metadata, available annotated frames, and an optional relink folder.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-droplet-training-io.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_training_io.py#L46) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Looks up only frames with saved annotations. Relinking returns a new record with the replacement folder and leaves the original session file unchanged.
